description: Phase-5 Slice 4b — blocksSelfServeCheckout PURE kernel golden corpus. Asserted by the REAL TS export (packages/api/src/services/billing.service.ts) in tests/billing/billing-service.test.ts AND the C# port Tims.Domain.Billing.BillingSelfServeKernel.BlocksSelfServeCheckout in Tims.UnitTests/Fixtures/BillingSelfServeKernelFixtureTests. Guards against a SECOND subscription-creating checkout (double billing): blocks a non-cancelled live Stripe subscription AND a paid local/manually-billed plan (stripeSubscriptionId null, plan != trial); allows a cancelled subscription (re-subscribe), a trial with no Stripe subscription, and a missing subscription row (null). A behavior change edits this JSON once; both stacks must agree.

cases.name: blocks a paid local/manually-billed plan with no Stripe subscription (professional/active)
blocks a paid local/manually-billed plan with no Stripe subscription (starter/past_due)
allows checkout when cancelled with a Stripe subscription id (re-subscribe)
allows checkout when cancelled with no Stripe subscription id
allows checkout for a trial with no Stripe subscription id
allows checkout for a missing subscription row
